title: Debtor Protection and Home-Equity Pledging in Small-Business Lending
abstract: Homestead protection shields an owner's home from creditors, preserving household wealth but also limiting a lender's recovery. We link SBA loans originated in 2011–2019 to mortgage and deed-of-trust records across 49 jurisdictions, and to business collateral and filing records in California, Colorado, and Florida. A 1 percent higher exemption amount is associated with 0.016 percentage points more home-equity pledging. Using an exogenous shift that admits marginal borrowers into the market, we find that lenders take home equity upfront where debtor protection is stronger.
